thread:
Alex H.: Quick planning question — we need a tenant-level throttle/heatmap + noisy-neighbor alert in Console. What's the minimal runtime metrics we should instrument?
Maya P.: Minimal set I think: per_tenant_qps, per_tenant_p95_ms, per_tenant_token_rate, per_tenant_gpu_util_pct
Juan C.: + per_tenant_active_streams and per_tenant_batch_size. Also need deployment_id and hashed_tenant_id tag. No raw names.
Rachel L.: Runtime can export Prom metrics. Suggest minute-rollups to avoid high-cardinality spikes. Tag schema: tenant_id=sha256(tenant_uuid), deployment, region
Sam O.: Cardinality alert: if we send full request_id tags we blow up TSDB. Pre-agg on the runtime and emit: tenant_id, metric, value, window=60s
Maya P.: Console UX: heatmap rows = tenants (top N by qps), cols = 5m buckets. Color = p95 latency. Clicking row shows token_rate + gpu_util trend.
Alex H.: For noisy neighbor detector, proposal for alert rule (rough sketch):
metrics-bot: ```promql
# tenant token domination
100 * sum by (tenant_id) (rate(per_tenant_token_rate[2m])) / sum(rate(cluster_token_rate[2m])) > 30
```
Maya P.: Also a GPU burst rule: ```promql
avg_over_time(per_tenant_gpu_util_pct[5m]) > 60 and avg_over_time(cluster_gpu_util_pct[5m]) < 80
```
Juan C.: We should add a suppression window and avoid flapping => require 10m consecutive breach before page.
Rachel L.: RBAC: dashboards should be per-org view by default. Allow support role to see cross-tenant heatmaps with audit logging. We must encrypt tenant_id in telemetry and only map in Console access layer.
Sam O.: Ingest side: make a new Kafka topic tenant-metrics-rollups, schema: tenant_hash(string), window_start(ts), metric(string), value(double), sample_count(int)
Alex H.: Action items:
- Alex H.: add runtime rollup + hashed tenant tag (ETA: Wed)
- Maya P.: mock Console heatmap and noisy-neighbor alert UI (ETA: Tue)
- Juan C.: write Prom rules + suppression config (ETA: Thu)
- Rachel L.: docs on RBAC/audit + privacy review (ETA: Fri)
Sam O.: I'll add the Kafka topic and produce a sample consumer for ingestion (I'll post schema in #eng-platform when ready)
Maya P.: one more: we need to ensure retention 30d for per-tenant high-res and 90d rolled-up. ops/finance ok with cost?
Alex H.: Good catch — I'll sync with finance after we have estimated cardinality. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
